notes.title: 1.6.2 Update + Updated Demoversion

tags.feature: [*] New musical accompaniment in some locations;

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug with an unreadable message in 1 act in the English version of the game.

notes.title: 03.04 – New PM (Update 1.6.1)

tags.feature: - Updated Makarov Pistol: a new model, sounds, updated animations;
- Updated Specular map for the phone;

notes.title: New game mode - "Arena"! 03.04 (Update 1.6.0)

tags.feature: [*] Added a new game mode “Arena” - how long can you hold out against your own demons ?;
[*] Added a new firearm - MAC-10 (only for the "Arena" game mode);
[*] New achievement: "My soul belongs to the demons";

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a defect related to sensitivity in the targeted mode;

notes.title: 03.04 - New game mode! (Update 1.5.0)

tags.feature: [*] Added a new game mode “Hardcore” - complete the game without firearms and without the possibility to save;
[*]  New cutscenes and epilogue: there is no longer that terrible change of pictures on a black background, everything is dynamic;
[*] Corrected lighting system: in the dark now really see at least something;
[*] Interaction button to activate the cutscene at the end of the first act;

tags.balance_change: [*] Melee weapons are balanced: a knife to inflict more damage, increased the defeat range, accelerated attacks;
[*] Corrected animations for NPC: it is easier to get closer and stab them;

tags.bug: [*] Removed texture falling in some locations;
[*] Removed the bug with a “pigtail” in the reflection of the mirror of the protagonist;

notes.title: 03.04 Update 1.4

tags.balance_change: [*] Weapon balance corrected - "soft" aiming, new walking animation, increased player's stock;

tags.feature: [*] Now if you do not have save, the game will not warn you about the beginning of a new game;

tags.bug: [*] Fix serious bugs - problems with the interacting with objects, stuck in textures;
[*] Fix animation failure when using TAB;

notes.title: "03.04" release in the game store Steam and 40% discount!
notes.content:
[h1]After a year of development, “03.04” saw the light on the counter of the Steam store and now it can be purchased and saved in the game library.[/h1]

[i]A demo version will be available on Steam later.[/i]

[u]At the moment the following is available in the game:[/u]
[list]
[*] Story mode. You can fully pass the story mode;
[*] Russian and English. In the settings you can switch between localizations.
[/list]

[u]Will be available in the following free updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Hardcore mode. Complete the game without any firearm - only a knife and first aid kits;
[*] Arena mode. Unusual survival with endless waves (questionable) of opponents.
[/list]

[u]From minor errors (Will be corrected with subsequent updates):[/u]
[list]
[*] The text in contact with the closed doors was not translated into English (“It’s jammed / Need a key / There is no sense to go back”);
[*] The text in the tooltips, after changing the location and then loading the game, can be translated to the wrong language that was chosen before.
[/list]

The game was developed by one person (with the exception of musical accompaniment) throughout 2018. The developer was inspired by the mod “Cry of fear” for the game Half-Life, its atmosphere in particular.

[u]Responsible for the music:[/u]
[list]
[*] Enthuse Music;
[*] ApatiaKrai.
[/list]

[b]Wish you a pleasant game![/b]
